messages.body: Hi Noel, I work with VOLTLEAF and would like to explore a YouTube integration with Frame Studio. The portable chargers could fit a camera-bag or location-shoot workflow. We are flexible on timing. Best, Mira

Hi Noel, following up on VOLTLEAF for Frame Studio. Portable charging while working on location could be a useful angle. If helpful, we can discuss a sample to try before deciding on a paid collaboration. Best, Mira
Hi Mira, I represent Frame Studio. We are interested in this opportunity. What are the next steps? Best, Noel
Thanks, Noel. Could you share Frame Studio's rate for one YouTube integration? I will discuss it with the client and prepare a more tailored brief. Best, Mira
One more question: what content angle would feel natural for Frame Studio? If a sample trial would help, you can also share a shipping address. Copying my colleague Nora here. Best, Mira

Hi Noel, confirming receipt, thank you. Could you share the rate for one 80–110 second YouTube integration and any content ideas? If a product trial would help, a sample shipping address is optional at this stage. Best, Nora
